result.summary: The home screen is mostly well laid out. The main visual defect is on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, where a loading spinner sits on top of the hero image, so the image looks stuck or partially loaded. Smaller polish issues affect text contrast and badge placement.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a circular loading spinner in the center of its hero image. The image appears stuck loading or half-rendered, while other images on the page have loaded.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the image finishes loading, and add a timeout with a fallback or retry. Use a skeleton or placeholder instead of a spinner over content, and hide the spinner once the image has loaded.

issues.description: Secondary text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen') is light gray on white and has low contrast. The gray search placeholder is also faint.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text color to meet WCAG AA contrast of at least 4.5:1.

issues.description: The time badges on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left edge of the illustration. They look slightly cramped and inconsistent with the image content, and the first badge overlaps the plate.
issues.suggestion: Give the badges consistent padding and position them clear of the main subject, or add a subtle shadow to separate them from the image.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons on the hero cards are inconsistent. The ramen card uses a dark translucent circle that is barely visible against the dark image, and the pizza card uses a different-looking button.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent favorite button style, such as a solid light circle with a dark icon, so it stays visible on any image.
